items.t: Carvana Is Up 22% in a Month. Is Its First 200,000-Car Quarter Really That Good?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysCarvana (CVNA:NYSE) stock is up 22% in the past month after selling a record 217,385 retail cars in the Q3, up 39%. It trails CarMax (KMX:NYSE) by about 10,000 cars a quarter.
